scientific_target: test whether existing graph reachability information adds held-out discrimination beyond an upstream pointwise environmental support score; islands are used as a fragmented-landscape test case, not as a special algorithm class

upstream_support.response: species presence_absence on the frozen A-Islands surveyed-island universe
upstream_support.island_extraction: area-weighted mean across each frozen island polygon; centroid fallback is not allowed without a separately frozen QC exception

cross_validation.rule: each island receives exactly one out-of-fold local-support prediction; folds are assigned before any EOG comparison
cross_validation.spatial_sensitivity: leave_one_Arch_lvl_1_out; report evaluability explicitly and do not replace the primary result with the sensitivity result

reachability.node_definition: one node per frozen surveyed island
reachability.environmental_state: the same four standardized CHELSA variables used by the upstream support producer
reachability.barrier_cost: zero in the primary A-Islands benchmark; no island-specific barrier category is added

interpretation_limits: bridge scores are not dispersal probabilities
paths are not inferred colonisation histories
a positive result does not establish a causal ocean barrier
a positive result supports added structural information beyond the frozen local-support producer only for the evaluated taxa and design
